title: Cargo Ships Grew Sixfold While Crews Shrunk To 20
hook: Cargo ships grew more than sixfold while crews fell to 20.
closing: More of the world's goods now depend on surprisingly few people at sea.
question: Would you work on that crew?

segments.say: Cargo capacity reached 24,327 container equivalents. A single vessel now moves what once required several ships.
Today's largest cargo ship stretches 400 meters. Its scale surpasses famous historic passenger liners.
A typical cargo crew fell to 20 people. Bigger ships now rely on smaller teams.
